summary.text: Troy Shelley is a Republican state representative from Utah House District 66 who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a small business owner with experience in marketing and the natural resources industry.

paragraphs.text: Troy Shelley's career experience includes working in marketing and the natural resources industry.
Shelley was a volunteer EMT and served as chair of the Sanpete County Republican Party.
Shelley took office in the Utah House in 2025, succeeding Steven Lund in District 66.
